text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while I'm walking along the
racetrack on
the academy grounds...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Backin' out would bring disgrace on the
good folk
of Edo! I say we go all in!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Very well. To uphold the honor of the
Kongo
Yaegaki style, I shall accept your
challenge.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Oh, haha... Inari's at it again.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Her fights are famous around the
academy after
all! Look, she's already
gathered an audience!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, don't worry. It isn't a literal fight or
anything.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Inari is always going around challenging
people
like that. Even I've had a run-in
with her!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Same. One minute, I hear her calling my
name,
and the next, I'm getting
challenged to a contest.

text_block_list.name: Student Onlookers
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Both Inari and City completed
their sets of
bench presses!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I guess we could call it a draw
then?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Don't be a buzzkill! That was just the
warm-up!
Now, how 'bout a deadlift
battle?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Fine by me. Seeing as it's come to this,
I'm
going no-holds-barred from here on
out.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Chiyono O! You do a nice
doggy
paddle! Could even consider it
top in the country!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Y-you think so? Am I doing that well?
Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, just watchin' ya has got me all
fired up!
Howza head-to-head a doggy
paddle battle
sound? Winner treats the
loser to some grub!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's like that saying! "Sometimes the
mouse
runs right into the cat's paw!" I'm
not going to
hold back, you know!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...She kind of goes around challenging
everyone
like that.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. Well, you can just see for
yourself.
choice_data_list: 迷惑になってるんじゃ……？

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
In that case, whaddaya say to a
2,000-meter
face-off today?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't have asked for a better
proposition! Let
us do battle!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, the two of them dash off
together.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Whoa, good stuff! Not bad at all, Yaeno!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I could say the same of you. Our duel
demanded
my complete focus. Truly, a
valuable lesson.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: You have my gratitude. Osu!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Whazza matter? Why ya bein' so
formal all
of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Lately, I'd been in a bit of a rut after
hitting a wall
in my training. Simply
standing on the track would
cause my
unease to grow stronger...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
But then you called out to me with a
passionate
challenge and helped me
rediscover the joy of
running!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa now, quit it with the flattery. I
only called
out to ya 'cause I wanted to
battle!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I was in a similar situation when Inari
challenged
me too. I was going through
a rough patch and
was feeling quite
worried.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
That's so Inari. It's like her own way of
looking out
for the rest of us.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whazzat?! Talkin' 'bout me, are ya? No
wonder
my nose was itchin' like crazy!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: How about runnin' your legs instead of your mouth? 'Gainst yours truly, the great Inari!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems Inari's straightforward energy
serves as a
source of support for those
around her. Gold City
and Chiyono O
break out into smiles at being
"called
out" by their peer.

serves as a
source of support for those
around her. Gold City
and Chiyono O
break out into smiles at being
"called
out" by their peer.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
All righty then! Let's do this, City,
Chiyono O! The
rest of ya, keep your
eyes peeled!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Let's gooooo! Full speed ahead!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Hrrraaahhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the trio engage in an
electrifying "fight"
that gets everyone's
hearts pumping!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
All right, then let's hit the track
together! City,
Chiyono O, and you too,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
And while we're at it, let's open this
battle up to
all comers! Form a line if
you're ready to rumble!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
This is Tracen Academy's first-ever epic
fight fest!
Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just like that, the academy's track
becomes one
big festival frenzy.
